fields.label: Sales sourcing (services and intangibles)
fields.value: Oregon uses market-based sourcing for receipts other than sales of tangible personal property. Receipts from services are sourced to Oregon if the service is delivered to a location in the state, and intangible property receipts are sourced based on use in Oregon.
fields.source_citation: 2025 Schedule OR-21-AP Instructions, Oregon Pass-through Entity Elective Tax Apportionment of Income 150-107-111-1
fields.quote: • Charges for a service, if the service is delivered to a loca - tion in Oregon.

fields.label: Forms
fields.value: Apportionment is computed on Schedule OR-AP, Apportionment of Income for Corporations and Partnerships. Electing pass-through entities filing Form OR-21 use Schedule OR-21-AP.
fields.source_citation: 2025 Schedule OR-AP Instructions, Apportionment of Income for Corporations and Partnerships, 150-102-171-1
fields.quote: Schedule OR-AP Instructions Apportionment of Income for Corporations and Partnerships 2025 This publication is a guide, not a complete statement, of Oregon Revised Statutes (ORS) and Oregon Administrative Rules (OAR).

fields.label: Income/franchise tax nexus
fields.value: Corporation excise tax applies to corporations doing business in Oregon, while corporation income tax applies to those deriving income from Oregon sources. Oregon asserts nexus based on a significant economic presence and maintains no bright-line factor nexus thresholds.
fields.source_citation: Oregon Department of Revenue : Foreign Corporations : Businesses : State of Oregon
fields.quote: "Doing business" means being engaged in any profit-seeking activity in Oregon.

fields.label: Sales/use tax: economic nexus
fields.value: Oregon does not impose a general state sales or use tax. As a result, there is no remote seller economic nexus threshold, transaction count, or measurement period.
fields.source_citation: Oregon Department of Revenue : Sales Tax in Oregon : Businesses : State of Oregon
fields.quote: Impacts to Oregonians shopping online The Wayfair decision doesn't affect Oregonians purchasing goods or services online because Oregon doesn't have a general sales tax.

fields.label: P.L. 86-272
fields.value: P.L. 86-272 protects businesses whose Oregon activity is limited strictly to solicitation of orders for sales of tangible personal property approved and filled from outside the state. Oregon adheres to a narrow interpretation following Multistate Tax Commission guidance, and the protection does not apply to the Corporate Activity Tax.
fields.source_citation: Oregon Department of Revenue : Foreign Corporations : Businesses : State of Oregon
fields.quote: 86-272 prohibits Oregon from imposing net income taxes on out-of-state companies selling tangible personal property whose business activities in Oregon are limited to the solicitation of orders by their employees or representatives.

fields.label: Sales and use tax
fields.value: Oregon does not impose a general state sales or use tax, and local jurisdictions do not add general sales taxes.
fields.source_citation: Oregon Department of Revenue : Sales Tax in Oregon : Businesses : State of Oregon
fields.quote: However, Oregon does have a vehicle use tax that applies to new vehicles purchased outside of the state.

fields.label: Individual due date and extension
fields.value: Individual returns are due on April 15 following the close of the tax year. Oregon honors the federal automatic 6-month extension to October 15, but state-only extensions require an extension payment by April 15 using Form OR-40-V or Revenue Online.
fields.source_citation: 2025 Publication OR-40-EXT, Instructions for Automatic Extension of Time to File Oregon Individual Income Tax Return, 150-101-165
fields.quote: If you’re using Form OR-40-V , be sure to include the begin- ning and ending dates of your fiscal year on the voucher.

fields.label: Composite returns
fields.value: Pass-through entities may file a composite return on Form OR-OC on behalf of eligible electing nonresident owners. For calendar-year entities, the return is due April 15, or October 15 on extension.
fields.source_citation: 2025 Publication OR-40-EXT, Instructions for Automatic Extension of Time to File Oregon Individual Income Tax Return, 150-101-165
fields.quote: Are you filing a composite return? If so, follow the exten- sion payment instructions but use Form OR-OC-V to send your payment.

fields.label: Key forms
fields.value: Key individual tax forms include Form OR-40, Form OR-40-P, and Form OR-40-N, while corporate returns include Form OR-20, Form OR-20-INC, and Form OR-CAT. Pass-through entities file Form OR-65, Form OR-20-S, Form OR-21, Form OR-OC, and Form OR-19.
fields.source_citation: 2025 Publication OR-17, Oregon Individual Income Tax Guide, 150-101-431
